room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "LWUHR": a fisherman's glowing fishing LURE gives off a faint glimmer in the dark aquarium, and a little fish swims toward it: LWUHR = LURE
note: Also figurative: une lueur d'espoir = a glimmer of hope.

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "op-skew-ree-TAY": a girl peeks into the pitch-black darkness booth: everything is OBSCURED except a raccoon's two glowing eyes: op-skew-ree-TAY = OBSCURE-ity
note: Also obscurity: a person or work that is little known (mourir dans l'obscurité).

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "klahr-TAY": a girl holds up a glass teapot of perfectly CLEAR TEA in a beam of light: klahr-TAY = CLEAR-TEA
note: Also clarity of an explanation (la clarté d'un texte).

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "lew-mee-noh-zee-TAY": a boy turns the big brightness dial up and the lamp glows so LUMINOUS that an owl on the lamp squints: lew-mee-noh-zee-TAY = LUMINOS-ity

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "lew-mee-NEUH": a LUMINOUS jellyfish glows in a big glass jar: lew-mee-NEUH = LUMINOUS

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "ay-bloo-ee-SAHN": a big dazzling diamond flashes BLUE light into a girl's eyes and she shields them: ay-BLOO-ee-sahn = A-BLUE-EE-sahn

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "ay-tan-suh-LAHN": a TIN SELLER polishes a tin pot on her cart until it is sparkling: ay-TAN-suh-LAHN = A-TIN-SELL-ON

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "bree-YAHN": the big crescent MOON lamp on the wall shines BRILLIANT gold over the room: bree-YAHN = BRILLIANT
note: Also brilliant of a person (un élève brillant = a brilliant student); as a noun, un brillant is a cut diamond.

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "ay-kleh-RAHZH": a stagehand aims a big spotlight so the little puppet stage is lit up CLEAR: ay-KLEH-rahzh = A-CLEAR-age
note: Also figurative: a new light on a question (sous un nouvel éclairage).

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "nay-AHN": a boy peers into a big empty black box, a total void, where only one NEON tube glows: nay-AHN = NEON
note: Philosophical nothingness or the void; réduire à néant = to wipe out completely.

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "lah-ZEHR": a cat chases the red dot of a LASER pointer up the wall: lah-ZEHR = LASER

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "ah-lew-MAHZH": a little wizard, a MAGE in a starry hat, pulls the big lever and ALL the lamps switch on: ah-lew-MAHZH = ALL-YOU-MAGE
note: Also a car's ignition (l'allumage du moteur).

room_name: Le cabinet des lumières · The cabinet of lights
hook: "SPEHKTR": a kid dressed as a friendly SPECTER in a bedsheet holds up a glass prism, and a rainbow SPECTRUM fans out beside him: SPEHKTR = SPECTER, SPECTRUM
note: Two senses: a ghost, and a spectrum of light or of opinions; figuratively a looming threat (le spectre du chômage).

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "TOOSH": a girl presses one piano KEY with a gentle TOUCH: TOOSH = TOUCH
note: Also a key or button on a keyboard, piano or phone, a brushstroke, and a bite on a fishing line; in sports, the touchline.

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "soh-NOR": the giant brass gramophone horn booms SO loud and resonant, yet the man lounging below SNORES right through it: soh-NOR = SO-SNORE

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "SOOR": a grandpa who is DEAF watches his grandson's sign language and nods 'SURE!': SOOR = SURE
note: Also muffled or dull of a sound (un bruit sourd) and faire la sourde oreille = to turn a deaf ear. As a noun (un sourd) prefer 'une personne sourde'.

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "voh-KAHL": a proud rooster belts out his CALL at the top of his voice: voh-KAHL = VO-CALL

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "moh-noh-TON": a little robot plays the same ONE NOTE over and over on a xylophone: moh-noh-TOHN = MONO-TONE
note: Also dull and unvarying of a life or landscape.

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "vah-KAHRM": what an uproar: a boy's VACuum cleaner roars while the big toy CAR's ALARM lights flash and wail: vah-KAHRM = VAC-ALARM
note: A loud din or racket; mildly negative.

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "see-fluh-MAHN": a SNIFFLY boy with a tissue jumps sky-high as the toy steam engine in his hands WHISTLES: see-fluh-MAHN = SNIFFLE-MAN

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "klah-kuh-MAHN": a flamenco MAN CLACKS his wooden castanets high over his head: klah-kuh-MAHN = CLACK-a-MAN

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "gran-suh-MAHN": Grandma's old rocking chair gives a long CREAK and GRAN SAYS 'MAN, that squeaks!': gran-suh-MAHN = GRAN-SAY-MAN
note: Also grincement de dents = gnashing of teeth.

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "tah-PAHZH": a boy TAP dances noisily on a wooden board: tah-PAHZH = TAP-age
note: Tapage nocturne is the legal offense of making noise at night; also a media fuss (faire du tapage).

room_name: Le cabinet des sons · The cabinet of sounds
hook: "shew-sho-tuh-MAHN": two kids sitting in a giant SHOE whisper secrets: shew-SHOH-tuh-mahn = SHOE-SHOW

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "frah-GRAHNS": a lady squeezes the bulb of a perfume bottle and a sweet FRAGRANCE drifts out: frah-GRAHNSS = FRAGRANCE

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "sewp-tee-lee-TAY": a perfume maker lets just ONE tiny drop fall from her glass dropper, so SUBTLE: soob-tee-lee-TAY = SUBTLE-ity

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "sah-voo-REUH": a girl closes her eyes to SAVOR a spoonful of sweet-smelling stew: sah-voo-RUH = SAVOR-uh

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "day-zah-gray-AHBL": two kids DISAGREE about the boiled cabbage: she pinches her nose and sticks out her tongue, he just shrugs and smiles: day-zah-gray-AHBL = DISAGREE-able
note: Also rude or unpleasant of a person.

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "ah-MEHR": A MAYOR in his tricolor sash bites a lemon and puckers at the bitter taste: ah-MAIR = A-MAYOR
note: Also bitter of a person or a memory (des regrets amers); un amer is also a sea landmark used by sailors.

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "ehg-zoh-TEEK": a parrot perches on a basket of EXOTIC fruit: pineapple, mango and dragon fruit: ehg-zoh-TEEK = EXOTIC
note: Can sound dated or othering when said of people; fine for fruit, plants and places.

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "SWAHV": a SUAVE gentleman in a velvet jacket breathes in the soft, sweet scent of a white gardenia: SWAHV = SUAVE
note: False friend: in French suave means soft and sweet (of a scent, voice or music), not smooth-talking.

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "oh-doh-RAH": the truffle pig's keen sense of smell sniffs out an ODOR... it's a RAT hiding in the basket: oh-doh-RAH = ODOR-RAT

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "ay-FLEWV": warm whiffs curl up from a pie as light as A FLUFF: eh-FLUV = A-FLUFF
note: Usually plural (des effluves); can be a pleasant waft or a bad smell.

room_name: Le cabinet des parfums · The cabinet of scents
hook: "day-GOO": a boy pinches his nose in DISGUST at an old sneaker dripping green GOO: day-GOO = DAY-GOO
note: Disgust or distaste; also weariness of something (le dégoût de la vie). Negative.
